blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and low power consumption, making them promising for speech-related applications. These include automatic lip reading, audiovisual speech analysis, and human-robot interaction, particularly in challenging environments characterized by low illumination or high dynamic range. Event-based lip reading, speaker recognition, and voice activity detection, however, mostly operate on a cropped region of interest (ROI), by hand or by the dataset, and no event-based method supplies that ROI as a spatial region; existing event-based face analysis gives the mouth as landmarks, which presents a mismatch between application and localization. The present work predicts a dense heatmap over the lip region from the full event "frame". Events are encoded as a polarity-separated voxel grid and processed at every location by a two-pathway continuous-time recurrent network (CT-RNN) with learned, log-space bounded time constants acting on the real elapsed time of each bin: a stateless fast pathway and a stateful slow pathway, utilised for refining and anchoring the prediction. The model reaches 69.5% on lips on four unseen speakers and switches target only 2.1 times per second, against 8.9 and 11.0 for convolutional baselines with
  more parameters. Adding a spatial encoder improves precision but fails on a new face scale. On a real event sensor, trained only on simulated events, the proposed model reaches 58.0% on lips against 43.2% for the CNN, with fewer than half its target switches.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Neuromorphic event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes asynchronously, producing a stream of timestamped events with a microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range, low latency, and low power consumption [ 10 ] . This makes them well-suited to rapid facial dynamics such as blinks and gaze, which demand a temporal precision beyond what fixed-rate sensors provide. These advantages do not transfer for free: a survey of neuromorphic face analysis [ 2 ] shows that detectors and landmark estimators built for RGB frames degrade sharply on event streams, producing low-confidence or degenerate predictions even on a clearly visible face, and that the field still lacks standardized, event-native detectors. As a result, event-based applications that need the face or mouth fall back on frame-based detectors or manual annotation. Lip localization matters most for speech. Visual speech carries predictive information for hearing: mouth movements precede the voice by 100 to 300 ms [ 6 ] , and seeing them speeds up the cortical processing of the auditory signal [ 28 ] . Listeners fuse the two streams within a temporal window of about 200 ms [ 29 ] , which a 25 to 30 fps camera covers with only five or six frames, so fast articulatory movements such as lip closures and releases fall between frames. Event cameras record these movements at a much higher temporal resolution and with less redundant information [ 27 ] , which motivates event-based lip reading and speech prediction, including applications for human–robot interaction. Event-based lip reading, speaker recognition, and voice activity detection all depend on the mouth region of interest (ROI), which, in the current applications, is either cropped by hand or localized from the events only as a point or a set of landmarks.
blocks.zh: 神经形态事件摄像头报告每像素亮度会同步变化,产生带有微秒时间分辨率,动态范围高,耐久性低,功耗低的时序事件流[10]. 这使得它们非常适合快速的面部动力学,例如眨眼和凝视,这需要时间精度超过固定速率传感器所提供的精度. 这些优势不会免费转移:神经形态面部分析调查[2]显示,为RGB帧建造的探测器和标志性估计器在事件流上急剧降解,即使清晰可见的面部也会产生低自信或退化的预测,场面仍然缺乏标准化的,事件内在的探测器. 因此,需要面部或口部的以事件为基础的应用在基于帧的探测器或人工注释上倒退. 利普本地化对言论来说最为重要. 视觉语音带有预测性听觉信息:口腔运动在语音前以100至300 ms [6],看到它们会加快听觉信号的皮质处理 [28]. 听觉者将两条溪流在大约200 ms [29] 的时间窗口内熔化,这个25到30 fps的相机盖上只有5到6帧,因此唇闭合和释放等快速的动脉运动在帧之间掉落. 事件摄像头记录这些运动的时间分辨率要高得多,并且使用更少的冗余信息[27],这激发了基于事件的唇读和语音预测,包括人类-机器人交互应用. 基于事件的唇读、扬声器识别和语音活动检测都取决于感兴趣的口腔区域(ROI),在目前的应用中,这些口腔区域要么是人工裁剪的,要么是仅作为某一点或一组地标从事件中本地化的。

blocks.en: 1.1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.1 相关工作

blocks.en: Face detection with event cameras was first shown on event-derived patches [ 1 ] ; [ 20 ] correlated ON and OFF activity against a temporal model of an eye blink, giving the first purely event-based face detector, and [ 24 ] learned face and eye tracking on simulated events, again relying on blinks.
blocks.zh: 与事件相机的面部探测首先在事件产生的补丁上显示;[20]与瞬间闪烁的瞬间模型相对应的相对应活动,给出了第一个纯粹基于事件的脸部探测器,[24]在模拟事件上学习到的脸部和眼睛跟踪,再次依靠闪烁.

blocks.en: Event-based lip reading recognizes spoken words from mouth motion. [ 27 ] introduced DVS-Lip, the first event-based lip-reading dataset, released with the lip region already extracted to a 128 × 128 128\times 128 window, and classified words by fusing a low- and a high-frame-rate branch. [ 5 ] proposed an end-to-end spiking network for the task, aimed at the low latency of embedded neuromorphic processing, and [ 7 ] extended spiking lip reading with signed spiking gated recurrent units. [ 32 ] reached competitive accuracy on DVS-Lip by attaching a reservoir node with fixed dynamics to every pixel, a per-pixel temporal encoding without a learned time constant. All four take the pre-extracted lip window as their input, so the crop is performed by the dataset rather than by the method, and none estimates where the lips are within a wider view. Beyond word recognition, [ 31 ] builds a speaker recognition system from lip motion recorded with an event camera; the lip region of each recording is annotated by hand and every sample is cropped to a 200 × 160 200\times 160 window that keeps only the events inside it. [ 15 ] does localize the lips before recognition, but with frame-based face and facial-feature detectors applied to a co-recorded conventional camera and to intensity images reconstructed from the events, rather than from the event stream itself.
blocks.zh: 以事件为基础的唇语读音能识别口语动作中的口语. [27]引入了DVS-Lip,这是第一个基于事件的唇读数据集,与已经提取到128×128128\times 128窗口的唇区域一起释放出来,并且通过引信一个低帧和高帧率的分支来分类词. [5]为任务提出了端对端的振荡网络,旨在降低嵌入式神经形态处理的潜伏性,[7]用签名的振荡门式经常性单元延长振荡唇读. [32] 在DVS-Lip上通过在每个像素上附加一个具有固定动力学的储油层节点,一个没有学习时间常数的每像素时间编码,达到了竞争的精度. 所有四个都以预先提取的唇窗作为输入,所以作物是由数据集而不是方法完成的,没有估计唇在较宽的视野内的位置. 除了文字识别外,[31]从用事件相机录制的唇动建立扬声器识别系统;每段录音的唇区域用手作注释,每段样本被裁成200×160200×160次160次窗口,只保留其中的事件. [15]在识别前确实将唇位本地化,但有基于帧的面部和面部特征探测器应用到共同录制的常规相机上,以及从事件而不是事件流本身重建的强度图像上.

blocks.en: For lip localization, [ 25 ] estimates the lip centre as a single point, only as the front end to a voice activity detection (VAD) classifier. [ 26 ] continues this VAD line but drops lip localization altogether, taking the mouth region directly from manual landmarks and collapsing its spatial structure into a temporal signal; joint spatial localization is explicitly set aside there as a harder problem. More recently, [ 17 ] places two of its five facial landmarks at the mouth corners while pursuing face detection and general landmark localization, and [ 18 ] predicts a ninety-eight-point face, with around twenty points along the mouth contour, for landmark and blink detection in driver monitoring. In both, the mouth points are read off a whole-face model after the face is cropped by a separate detector.
blocks.zh: 对于唇局部化,[25]估计唇中心为单点,仅作为语音活动检测器(VAD)的前端. [26] 继续这一VAD线,但完全放弃了唇位化,将口区直接从手动地标上划出,使其空间结构崩溃成一个时空信号;联合空间定位被明确搁置在那里,成为一个更棘手的问题. 最近,[17]在追求脸部检测和一般地标本地化的同时,在嘴角放置了它的五个面部地标中的两个,[18] 预测一个98分的脸,沿嘴轮廓约20分,用于在驾驶员监测中进行地标和眨眼检测. 在两者中,口点在面部被单独的探测器收割后读出一个整面模型.

blocks.en: 1.2 Problem Statement
blocks.zh: 1.2 问题说明

blocks.en: Taken together, existing work leaves three gaps: • Task and output: Applications of event-based lip analysis consume a mouth region: lip reading runs on data already restricted to the mouth [ 27 ] , speaker recognition on a hand-cropped lip window [ 31 ] , and voice activity detection on a mouth region taken from manual landmarks [ 26 ] . The methods that do locate the mouth return a single point [ 25 ] or a few landmarks from a whole-face model that itself needs a face crop [ 18 ] , so a region must still be rebuilt before any of these applications can run. • Representation: HOTS-style time surfaces [ 19 ] and locally adaptive decay surfaces [ 17 ] collapse a window of events into a single 2D surface in which each pixel holds a decayed summary of its recent activity, so the order of events within the window is lost. Event histograms keep polarity but discard timing in the same way. Voxel grids [ 34 ] keep the timing in bins, but in their standard form sum signed polarity into one channel. Learned grid representations [ 13 ] can keep both, but at an added computational cost. Polarity is handled inconsistently across these representations: time-surface methods keep ON and OFF on separate surfaces [ 19 ] , while ordinal surfaces such as EROS [ 11 ] drop polarity altogether; where polarity is merged into one channel, opposite polarities can cancel at the lip boundary and erase the signed edge structure that marks the moving contour. • Temporal stability: Some of the methods in Table 1 carry temporal state, through recurrent layers [ 18 ] or decaying surfaces [ 17 ] , yet methods that work on localization are evaluated on per-frame accuracy, such as landmark error or the share of frames localized within a tolerance [ 25 , 18 , 17 ] . A lip ROI should remain on the mouth from one window to the next, a property that has not yet been measured for this task.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,现有工作留下三个空白: 任务和产出:基于事件的唇分析的应用消耗一个口腔区域:唇读数运行在已经限于口腔的数据上 [27] ,在手握嘴窗上的扬声器识别 [31],以及从手动地标上提取的口腔区域语音活动检测 [26]. 确定口位的方法从一个本身需要面料作物的整面模型中返回一个点[25]或几个地标[18],所以在任何这些应用能够运行之前,一个区域仍然必须重建. • 支助 代表:HOTS风格的时间表面 [19] 和局部适应性衰变表面 [17] 坍塌一个事件窗口,形成一个单一的2D表面,其中每个像素都持有其近期活动的衰变摘要,因此窗口内事件顺序丢失. 事件直方图保持极性 但以同样的方式丢弃时间 Voxel网格 [34] 将时间用bins保持,但在其标准形式总和上签名的极性进入一个通道. 学会的网格表示[13]可以保留两者,但以额外的计算成本计算. 极性在这些表达方式之间处理不一致:时间表方法在单独的表面保持上和下,而平面如EROS[11] 完全下降极性;如果极性合并为一个通道,对面极性可以在唇边界上取消,并抹去标志运动轮廓的签名边缘结构。 • 时间稳定性: 表1中的一些方法带有时间状态,通过反复层[18]或衰变表面[17],然而本地化的方法则按每帧的准确性来评价,如地标误差或在耐受度范围内本地化的帧比例[25,18,17]. 从一个窗口到另一个窗口的嘴上应保留一个唇形的ROI,这一财产尚未为这项任务进行测量。

blocks.en: This work proposes a solution to these gaps: a model that outputs the lip region from the event stream, and an evaluation of its temporal stability. To the authors’ knowledge, no event-based method treats the lip ROI as its primary objective: the closest estimates only the lip centre for voice activity detection [ 25 ] , and landmark methods read the mouth off a whole-face model after a face crop [ 18 , 17 ] . The proposed model goes beyond these by predicting a dense lip heatmap from the full, uncropped event frame, as a front end for lip analysis. A two-pathway continuous-time recurrent network (CT-RNN) [ 9 ] , using the time-aware update of liquid time-constant networks [ 14 ] , reads the events at every location: a stateless fast pathway follows lip motion, and a stateful slow pathway keeps a memory that anchors the prediction.
blocks.zh: 这项工作提出了解决这些差距的办法:一种从活动流中输出唇区域的模式,以及对其时间稳定性的评价。 据作者所知,没有一种基于事件的方法将唇-ROI作为首要目标:最接近的估计只是语音活动检测的唇-中心[25],标志性的方法在面部收缩后读取了整面模型的嘴[18,17]. 拟议的模型超越了这些范围,从完整的,未剪切的事件框架中预测出密集的唇热图,作为唇分析的前端. 一个双路径连续的经常性网络(CT-RNN)[9],利用液态时间恒定网络的时知更新[14],读取每个地点的事件:无国籍的快速路径遵循唇动,状态慢路径保存着支撑预测的记忆.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are: • Event-based lip localization formulated as a front end for lip analysis, predicting a dense lip region from the full uncropped event frame. • A two-pathway CT-RNN applied per spatial location over polarity-separated bins, with learned time constants acting on real elapsed time, a stateless fast pathway and a stateful slow pathway, trained on a pooled RGB teacher whose uncertainty the network also predicts. • An evaluation on unseen speakers against frame-wise convolutional baselines that reports temporal stability alongside accuracy, and an analysis of how spatial context trades accuracy against robustness to new speakers. • A transfer to real event sensors in which, with all models trained on simulated data, the proposed model outperforms the CNN in both on-lips rate and stability.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献是: • 将基于事件的唇定位作为唇分析的前端,从完全未剪开的事件框架中预测一个密集的唇区域。 • 每个空间位置在极性分离的垃圾箱上采用双向CT-RN,学习时间常数按实际经过的时间运行,无国籍快速路径和状态缓慢路径,培训一个集合式RGB教师,其网络也预测其不确定性。 • 支助 对照报告时间稳定性和准确性的框架演化基线,对看不见的发言者进行评价,并分析空间背景如何与新发言者的稳健性相匹配。 • 支助 向真实事件传感器的转让,在其中,所有模型都经过模拟数据培训,拟议的模型在平面率和稳定性上都超过了CNN。

blocks.en: 2 Data
blocks.zh: 2 数据

blocks.en: Training uses one simulated set; evaluation adds sequences of speaking faces selected from two real event-camera datasets. The simulated set contains 12 speakers (8 male, 4 female) recorded with a conventional camera at 30 frames per second while reading teleprompter prompts at a natural pace, with no face or mouth crop. Speakers S2–S7 are used for training, S8–S9 for validation, and S10–S13 are held out as unseen test speakers; S1 is a mock user and is not used. The real sets are Faces in Event Streams (FES) [ 4 ] , which provides face boxes and five facial landmarks including the mouth corners, and FACEMORPHIC [ 3 ] , which records RGB video alongside the event stream, although the two are not spatially aligned.
blocks.zh: 培训使用一个模拟数据集;评价增加了从两个真正的事件-相机数据集中选择的说话面孔序列。 模拟集包含12个扬声器(8个男性,4个女性),用常规相机录制,每秒30帧,而读取电讯速记则以自然的速度发出,没有面部或口部收割. S2-S7的演讲者用于培训,S8-S9用于验证,S10-S13作为隐形测试演讲者被保留;S1是一个模拟用户,没有使用. 真实的镜头是事件流中的Faces(FES)[4],它提供面盒和包括口角在内的五个面部地标,以及FACEMORPHIC[3],它与事件流一起记录RGB视频,虽然两者没有空间对齐.

blocks.en: Event simulation. Each clip is upsampled from 30 Hz to 320 Hz with the frame interpolation of VID2E [ 12 ] and converted to events with ESIM [ 22 ] at a contrast threshold of 0.2 0.2 ; one event transition spans two consecutive interpolated frames, 6.25 ms. Coordinates and timestamps are normalised to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ; windows above 20k events (corrupt interpolations) are dropped and the rest capped at 10k.

blocks.en: A temporal stage is applied independently at every spatial location, across the K K bins, with weights shared over locations in the manner of a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution applied recurrently. At each location the encoded bins are read in order by a continuous-time recurrent cell (CT-RNN) [ 9 ] in rate form, τ ​ h ˙ = − h + f \tau\,\dot{h}=-h+f , where each unit carries its own learned time constant τ \tau . Rather than an Euler update, the cell uses an exponential step that holds f f over the real bin duration, Equation 1 : h ← f + ( h − f ) exp ( − Δ t / τ ) , h\leftarrow f+(h-f)\,\exp(-\Delta t/\tau), (1) where Δ ​ t \Delta t is the duration of a bin and f f is the candidate activation, f = tanh ⁡ ( W in ​ x t + W rec ​ h + b ) , f=\tanh\!\big(W_{\mathrm{in}}\,x_{t}+W_{\mathrm{rec}}\,h+b\big), (2) computed from the encoded bin x t x_{t} and the previous state h h . The update follows the closed-form, time-aware update of liquid time-constant (LTC) networks [ 14 ] . Initially an LTC was chosen, but as the time constant was kept constant per unit in two timescales instead of a liquid state, it has become a CT-RNN. This lets the update act on the real duration of a bin, so the temporal behaviour depends on elapsed time; the constant τ \tau keeps each pathway in its timescale, and the state stays bounded, at a small parameter count. Each time constant is learned through a raw parameter τ raw \tau_{\mathrm{raw}} and bounded to [ τ min , τ max ] [\tau_{\min},\tau_{\max}] by a sigmoid in log space, Equation 3 : τ = exp ⁡ ( log ⁡ τ min + ( log ⁡ τ max − log ⁡ τ min ) ​ σ ​ ( τ raw ) ) . \tau=\exp\!\big(\log\tau_{\min}+(\log\tau_{\max}-\log\tau_{\min})\,\sigma(\tau_{\mathrm{raw}})\big). (3) Bounding τ \tau in log space keeps a gradient at every value, so no unit is frozen at a bound as with a hard clamp, and lets one optimiser step change τ \tau by a ratio, so units from milliseconds to seconds are trained at a comparable rate.

blocks.en: Inference. The heatmap is thresholded at 0.3 0.3 and split into connected components; no output is given when the heatmap peak is below 0.35 0.35 . A lightweight tracker selects the component with the highest peak, rejects jumps of more than 10 cells while a nearer candidate exists, holds the last region for up to 12 windows when nothing is detected, and re-anchors when a better component persists; the output is the heatmap-weighted centroid of the selected component. The same tracker is applied to every compared model.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: Protocol. Models are evaluated on four unseen speakers S10–S13, 59,846 windows in total; windows with interpolation errors or no detectable face are excluded. A prediction is on lips when its centre falls in the lip box, and on the eye when its centre is closer to the eye than to the lip.
blocks.zh: 协议。 模型在4个看不见的扬声器S10-S13、59 846个窗口上进行评估;没有内插错误或没有可探测面孔的窗口除外。 一个预测是在唇上,当其中心落在唇盒中,而其中心靠近眼睛而不是唇时,则在眼睛上.

blocks.en: During development, early models included too many sparse events from facial features (like the beard) in the predicted region. As the predicted region became more precise and smaller, the errors moved to the eye, which has a similar event pattern to the lip; the eye rate is therefore reported.
blocks.zh: 在开发过程中,早期的模型包含了来自预测区域面部特征(如胡须)的过多零星事件. 随着预测的区域变得更加精确和小,错误移到眼上,而眼上的事件模式与唇类似;因此报告了眼速率.

blocks.en: Precision is reported as the median and 90th-percentile centre error, the share of windows within 10 px, and the share with IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 . Stability is reported as switches , the number of times per speaking second that the output leaves the lips for another location, the mean streak , the time the output stays on the lips without interruption, and jitter , the RMS window-to-window motion of the predicted centre beyond that of the reference, in cells of the 64 × 64 64\times 64 heatmap.
blocks.zh: 精确度报告为中位数和90百分率中心误差、10px内的窗口份额和IoU = 0.5\geq的份额 0.5 (英语). 稳定性被报告为开关,每说话次输出离开嘴唇到另一个位置的次数,平均长度,输出不间断地停留在嘴唇上的时间,以及热潮,预测中心在参考中心以外的RMS窗口到窗口运动,在64×64\时间64热潮的单元格中。

blocks.en: 4.1 Baseline comparison
blocks.zh: 4.1 基线比较

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the baselines trained on the same data. The CNN is the best when it comes to precision, at 75.6% on lips with a median error of 11.2 px, and 44.9% of its windows fall within 10 px. Second is the proposed model, with 69.5%, 16.2 px and 24.6%. The proposed model is the most stable. It leaves the lips 2.1 times per second against 8.9 for the CNN and 11.0 for the U-Net, and once on the lips it stays there for 326 ms on average, 3.7 times longer than the CNN. Its jitter is less than half that of the CNN, 2.8 against 6.0 cells. The deep-encoder variant matches this stability, 2.1 switches per second with the lowest jitter of 1.9 cells, at a lower on-lips rate of 66.4%. The U-Net confuses the lips with the eyes most often, in 15.7% of windows. Fig. 3 shows this trade-off between precision and stability.
blocks.zh: 表2根据同一数据比较了培训的基线。 CNN精准度最高,在唇上为75.6%,中值误差为11.2px,其44.9%的窗口在10px之内. 二是拟议型号,占69.5%,16.2px和24.6%. 拟议的模式是最稳定的。 它的嘴唇为每秒2.1次,而CNN为8.9次,U-Net为11.0次,一次在嘴唇上平均停留326米,比CNN长3.7倍. 它的热量不到CNN的一半,2.8对6.0细胞. 深编码器的变体与这种稳定性相匹配,每秒2.1开关与1.9个电池的最低热量相匹配,在页上率较低,为66.4%。 U-Net将嘴唇与眼睛混淆的频率最高,在15.7%的窗口中. 图3显示了精确性和稳定性之间的这种权衡。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : On-lips rate against switches per second.
blocks.zh: 图3:每秒开关的开关率。

blocks.en: 4.2 Scale Shift and Spatial Context Trade-off
blocks.zh: 4.2 规模变化和空间背景

blocks.en: The memory is stress tested by resetting the slow state at every window and by removing each pathway, with the weights unchanged; this experiment is a test-time ablation without retraining. Without the memory, the model becomes more willing to predict, in 99.8% of windows against 98.6%, but it is a lot less precise and less stable. Switching rises from 2.1 to 9.3 per second, the mean streak drops from 326 to 67 ms, close to the CNN and U-Net baselines, and both the eye hits (6.3 to 11.5%) and the median error (16.2 to 23.3 px) increase. Removing the slow pathway completely has the same effect and worsens the results further. Removing the fast pathway gives the opposite trade-off: the model becomes more stable, with 0.8 switches per second and half the jitter, but less precise, with a median error of 17.4 px. The trade-off is that the slow state holds the prediction on the lip, while the fast pathway keeps it responsive and precise, so the design choice of holding both stands. This design, however, has a speed trade-off: the 16 bins per window take about 5 ms, against 1.4 ms for the CNN on the same GPU, both still below 6.25 ms.
blocks.zh: 内存通过在每个窗口重置慢态和去除每条路径来测试压力,重量不变;这一实验是一次不进行再培训的试验时间衰竭. 没有记忆,模型就更愿意预测,在99.8%的窗口相对于98.6%的窗口中,但它的精确度和稳定性都低得多. 切换率从每秒2.1升至9.3,平均径从326米降至67米,接近CNN和U-Net基线,眼睛点击率(6.3%至11.5%)和中位误差(16.2至23.3px)均增加。 清除缓慢路径具有同样的效果,使结果进一步恶化。 移除快速路径给出了相反的权衡:模型变得更加稳定,每秒0.8开关和半开关,但不太精确,中间误差为17.4px. 权衡的是,慢态在唇上保持了预测,而快速路径则保持了响应性和精确性,因此在设计上选择了两个站位. 然而,这种设计有一个速度权衡:每扇窗口的16个垃圾箱需要约5ms,而同一GPU上的CNN则需要1.4ms,两者都还低于6.25ms.

blocks.en: Table 4: Test-time ablation of the proposed model.
blocks.zh: 表4:拟议模型的试验时间。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that the deep-encoder variant performs a lot better on S12, which was a common outlier for all baselines (the U-Net failed on both outliers); the deep-encoder variant got 65.3% on lip, but it creates a new outlier in S13, with 17.6% compared to 79.3%. S13 is an interesting speaker: the camera was very close to them, so their features appear at a different scale. If the memory generalises, why does S13 drop when a deep encoder is added?
blocks.zh: 表2显示深编码器的变体在S12上表现得更好,它是所有基线的常见的离子(在两个离子上U-Net都失败了);深编码器的变体在唇形上得到65.3%,但在S13上创造了新的离子,与79.3%相比有17.6%. S13是一个有趣的演讲者:相机非常接近他们,因此其特征以不同的尺度出现. 如果内存概括,为什么在添加深编码器时S13会下降?

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Fast and slow pathway states of the proposed model and of the deep-encoder variant.
blocks.zh: 图4:拟议模型和深编码器变体的快速和缓慢路径状态。

blocks.en: Looking at the feature maps of the pathways in Fig. 4 , the memory no longer sees most of the face features by the time it receives the input from the encoder. The lip target is already isolated, with no reference point in the face, which stops the model from generalizing to a new scale. This also explains why CNN models are generally more precise: they fit themselves closely to the supervised target, but cannot learn the general features of the face. This was a common issue as well with the U-Net, which dropped to 31.9% on S13; removing the skip connections from the deep-encoder variant did not help, and it performed similarly.
blocks.zh: 查看Fig. 4中路径的特征图,内存在接收编码器输入时不再看到大部分面部特征. 唇形目标已经孤立,面部没有参考点,这阻止了模型从泛化到一个新的尺度. 这也解释了为什么CNN模型一般比较精确:它们本身与被监督的目标很接近,但无法学习面部的一般特征. 这也是U-Net的一个共同问题,在S13上降至31.9%;从深编码器变体中去掉跳转连接没有帮助,它的表现类似。

blocks.en: 4.3 Failure Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 失败分析

blocks.en: This section showcases where the proposed model fails, visualising the limitations that were discussed earlier and discussing test cases and their failure points. By now the deep-encoder variant is established to be more precise and has better jitter compared to the proposed model, but as mentioned before, changing the scale of features makes it fail.
blocks.zh: 本节展示了拟议模型失败之处,可视化了先前讨论的局限性,并讨论了测试案例及其故障点. 现在已经确定深编码器的变体更为精确,与拟议的模型相比有更好的焦虑,但如前所述,改变特征的规模使其失败。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Error maps of the proposed models.
blocks.zh: 图5:拟议模型的误差图。

blocks.en:
The deep-encoder variant failed in that test case because its predictions shifted down (Fig. 6 ), not because it is less precise; the features that help it anchor the results on a new scale are discarded at the encoder level, but with other speakers it is better. Fig. 5 shows the error maps of both models.
Establishing this weakness of the proposed model can only be done through an outlier removal procedure between the variants: removing the proposed model’s outlier and the variant’s outlier, the proposed model is weaker even if a full comparison shows it is better; on the remaining sequences of S10 and S11, its hit rate is 91.6% and the variant’s is 95.8%, with a median error of 12.0 px against 9.5 px.
blocks.zh:
深编码器变体在测试中失败了,因为它的预测向下移(图6),不是因为它不够精确;帮助它在新的尺度上锁定结果的特性在编码器一级被抛弃,而是与其他发言者一起更好。 图5显示了两种模型的错误图.
确定拟议模型的这一弱点只能通过不同变体之间的异端清除程序进行:去除拟议模型的异端和变体的异端,即使全面比较表明情况较好,拟议的模型也较弱;在S10和S11的其余序列中,它的命中率为91.6%,变体为95.8%,中间误差为12.0px对9.5px.

blocks.en: The design of the test cases takes into account testing what the model was trained on and what it was not. S10 was recorded normally with little head motion, only enough to generate events, and the model is on lip 91.7%. S11 was recorded in a different setting to the majority of the test data but also had a similar case of small head movement, on lip at 75.7%. S12 is the hardest speaker for the proposed model and the CNN due to the head motion; the model fails with 31.9% on lip, with the highest eye hit at 12.3%. S13 is recorded close to the camera, and the model still hits 79.3% on lip, with an eye rate of 5.9%. The deep-encoder variant was created to solve the S12 outlier, but instead it failed in generalizing a close target, with only 17.6% on lip on S13.
blocks.zh: 测试案例的设计考虑到测试模型所训练的是什么和它没有。 S10通常记录时头部运动小,仅足以产生事件,模型在唇形91.7%. S11是在与大多数试验数据不同的环境下记录的,但也有一个类似的小头运动案例,在唇上为75.7%。 由于头部运动,S12是拟议型号以及CNN最难的演说者;型号以31.9%的嘴唇失效,最高的眼球命中率为12.3%. S13在相机附近录制,型号在唇上仍达到79.3%,眼速率为5.9%。 深编码器的变体是用来解决S12的输出器的,但是它却未能将一个近目标概括起来,在S13上的唇上只有17.6%.

blocks.zh: 图6:实例预测 注:为了保护志愿人员的匿名性而种植

blocks.en: 4.4 Real Event-Sensor Transfer
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 真实事件 - 传感器传输

blocks.en: The biggest advantage the proposed model gains is in its real sensor results, compared with the CNN, the strongest baseline model. FES [ 4 ] is not a lip-reading dataset, so only a subset of clips where the speakers were speaking was picked. Seen in Table 5 , the proposed model outperforms the CNN on FES, with 58.0% on lips against 43.2%, a median error of 17.6 px against 28.4 px, and far fewer eye hits (2.3% against 11.9%). It is also more stable, with 5.0 against 12.4 switches per second and 126 ms against 42 ms streaks. Per sequence, the proposed model is better on 8 of the 12 clips.
blocks.zh: 与CNN相比,拟议的模型增益最大的优势在于其真正的传感器结果,这是最强的基准模型. FES [4] 不是一个读唇数据集,所以只选了发言者发言的片段。 从表5中可以看出,拟议的模型在FES上的表现优于CNN,其双唇58.0%对43.2%,中值误差为17.6px对28.4px,眼球命中率更低(2.3%对11.9%). 它还比较稳定,每秒5.0对12.4开关,42毫秒对126毫秒开关。 每个序列,在12个片段中的8个片段上,提议的模型更好.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Transfer to a real event sensor (FES). Both models are trained only on simulated data.
blocks.zh: 表5:向真实事件传感器(FES)转让。 这两个模型只接受模拟数据方面的培训。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : FES examples [ 4 ] , predicted center per window against the ground-truth.
blocks.zh: 图7:FES实例[4],预测每个窗口的中心与地面真相相对应。

blocks.en: As seen in the top row of Fig. 7 , the proposed model is much more stable, with the CNN jumping in the x x and y y positions. The second row shows a big weakness of the proposed model: when the memory commits to the wrong prediction, it stays there. The model started on the lip, then moved to a wrong region and stayed there, while the CNN, predicting without memory, recovers from wrong predictions. The bottom row shows a case where both find the lip to an equivalent measure, and the proposed model is still much more stable.
blocks.zh: 如图7的上行所示,提议的模型要稳定得多,CNN跳跃于xx和yy的位置. 第二行显示了拟议模型的一大弱点:当记忆承诺错误的预测时,它会停留在那里. 该模型开始于唇形,然后移动到一个错误的区域并停留在那里,而CNN在没有记忆的情况下预测,从错误的预测中恢复过来. 下行显示一个案例,两者都发现唇与等量,而拟议的模型仍然比较稳定.

blocks.en: As FACEMORPHIC [ 3 ] RGB is not well aligned, there is no ground truth to test; however, stability can be tested, shown in Fig. 8 where every predicted centre of a recording is connected to the next one and drawn on a single frame. The proposed model stays in a compact cluster around the mouth, with a few jumps. The CNN jumps to the background often, predicting outside the face during silent activity and anchoring to the noise, while in the recordings inspected the proposed model predicted less during silent behavior.
blocks.zh: 由于FACEMORPHIC [3] RGB没有很好的对齐,因此没有地面真理可以测试;然而,稳定性可以测试,用Fig表示. 8,一个录制的每一个预测中心都连接到下一个中心,并画在一个单帧上. 提议的模型停留在紧凑的集群中,环绕嘴部,有一些跳跃. CNN经常跳向背景,在静默活动时预测面部外侧,并锁定噪音,而录音中则检查拟议模型在静默行为时预测较少.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The discussion follows the three gaps of the problem statement, then the transfer to a real sensor.
blocks.zh: 讨论遵循了问题说明的三个漏洞,然后转移到真正的传感器.

blocks.en: Task and output: The proposed model localizes the lip region as a dense map from the full event frame, without a face detector or crop, the input that lip reading, speaker recognition, and voice activity detection consume. It is on the lips in 69.5% of windows on unseen speakers; however, the CNN outperforms it in precision, with a median error of 11.2 against 16.2 px.
blocks.zh: 任务和产出 : 拟议的模型将唇区域定位为来自整个事件框架的密集地图,没有面部探测器或作物、唇读、扬声器识别和语音活动探测所消耗的输入。 但CNN精确地超过了它, 中值误差为11.2比16.2px。

blocks.en: Representation: Unlike time surfaces or summed-polarity grids, the polarity-separated voxel grid keeps both event order and polarity, so this gap is addressed by design; the baselines use the same grid and share this. The grid keeps event order in bins of fixed duration, which the fast pathway reads in order within a window; removing it raises the median error from 16.2 to 17.4 px (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 代表: 与时间表面或集合极性网格不同,极性分离的阴极网格既保持事件顺序,又保持极性,因此这一缺口通过设计解决;基线使用相同的网格并共享. 网格在固定持续时间的垃圾箱中保持事件顺序,快速路径在窗口中按顺序读取;删除时将中位错误从16.2 px(表4 )提升至17.4 px(表4 ).

blocks.en: Temporal stability: Temporal stability is the advantage of the proposed model over the CNN: it leaves the lip 2.1 times per second against 8.9, holds an on lip streak 3.7 times longer, and has half its jitter. Resetting the slow state at every window raises switching to 9.3 per second, close to the baselines, linking this stability to the memory. The slow pathway, with τ \tau up to 2 s, keeps most of its state across windows and anchors the prediction, while the fast pathway follows the lip motion and keeps the model responsive.
blocks.zh: 时间稳定性:时间稳定性是拟议模型相对于CNN的优势:它使嘴唇每秒2.1次对8.9次,保持了3.7倍长的唇纹,并有一半的焦躁。 在每个窗口重置慢态会提高切换到每秒9.3,接近基线,将这种稳定性与内存联系起来. 慢路径 \ tau 最多 2 s , 使其大部分状态贯穿窗口并锁定预测, 而快速路径则遵循唇动并保持模型响应 。

blocks.en: Transfer to a real sensor: On FES, the proposed model leads the CNN on every metric (Table 5 ), with 58.0% against 43.2% on lips and a jitter of 5.1 against 13.9 cells; on FACEMORPHIC, during silent behaviour, the CNN predicts on background noise, while in the inspected recordings the proposed model predicts less (Fig. 8 ). The real sensor changes the contrast threshold and noise of the events; this does not prove the effectiveness of the mechanism, but it shows that the temporal memory generalizes better to it than the frame-wise CNN.
blocks.zh: 转让到真正的传感器: 在FES方面,拟议模型领先CNN的每个度量(表5),唇为58.0%,对43.2%,对13.9个细胞为5.1;在FACEMORPHIC方面,CNN在无声行为期间预测背景噪音,而在检查的录音中,拟议模型预测较少(图8)。 真实的感应器会改变事件的对比阈值和噪音;这并不能证明机制的有效性,但它表明时间记忆对它的概括性比帧式的CNN更好.

blocks.en: In summary, the results address the task and temporal stability gaps, and the design addresses the representation gap; the memory brings stability and generalization to the real sensor, at the cost of precision against the CNN on simulated data.
blocks.zh: 简言之,结果解决了任务和时间稳定性差距,设计解决了表现差距;内存给真实的传感器带来了稳定性和泛化,以在模拟数据上相对于CNN的精度为代价.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Training data is limited to simulated events with a fixed contrast threshold, and on the real sensor the on-lips rate drops. The frame-wise CNN outperforms the proposed model in precision; the advantage of the proposed model is temporal stability. The memory that creates this stability is also a weakness: once the recurrent state commits to a wrong region, the model stays there, while the CNN recovers (Fig. 7 , second row). S12 shows a weakness under head motion, and the deep-encoder variant recovers S12 but, relying on spatial layout, breaks under a new scale.
blocks.zh: 训练数据仅限于模拟具有固定对比阈值的事件,在真传感器上,上皮率下降. 采用帧式的CNN精准地超过了提议的模型;提议的模型的优点是时间稳定性. 创造这种稳定性的记忆也是一个弱点:一旦反复出现的状态对一个错误的区域作出承诺,模型就留在那里,而CNN恢复(图7,第二行). S12显示出头部运动下的弱点,深编码器变体恢复S12,但依靠空间布局,在新的尺度下断裂.

blocks.en: Future work could add a recovery mechanism for when the state commits to a wrong region, scale-aware augmentation, and a direct comparison of event representations, and could combine the localized ROI with the pathway memory for event-based lip reading without a manual crop.
blocks.zh: 未来的工作可以增加一种恢复机制,用于国家承诺错地区、扩大规模和直接比较事件表现,并且可以将本地化的ROI和基于事件的唇读的路径记忆结合起来,而无需人工收割。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Mouth movements precede the voice and are fused with it within about 200 ms, a window that event cameras record at a much higher temporal resolution than frame cameras. Event-based lip applications, however, still depend on a lip ROI given by hand or by the dataset, while existing event-based methods localize the mouth only as a point or a set of landmarks; localizing the lip region directly from the events is the front end they are missing, and this work provides it.
blocks.zh: 口腔运动先于声音,与声音结合在约200米以内,这个窗口,事件摄像头以比帧摄像头高得多的时间分辨率记录下来. 然而,基于事件的唇语应用仍然依赖于手或数据集给出的唇语ROI,而现有的基于事件的方法仅将嘴作为点或一组地标本地化;直接从事件上本地化的唇语区域是它们缺失的前端,这项工作提供了它.

blocks.en: The proposed model predicts the lip region from uncropped event streams with a polarity-separated voxel grid and a two-timescale continuous-time memory trained with teacher uncertainty. The frame-wise CNN outperforms it in precision, but the proposed model tracks the mouth more robustly, with about four times fewer switches and longer streaks. On a real event sensor, it outperforms the CNN in both on-lips rate and temporal stability despite training only on simulated events, and on FACEMORPHIC it keeps a compact track while the CNN jumps across the frame. The results show that temporal memory transfers better than spatial appearance for event-based lip localization, and that temporal stability should be reported alongside accuracy.
blocks.zh: 拟议模型从未剪切的事件流中预测唇区域,其极性分离的voxel网格和两次规模连续的内存训练有师的不确定性. 以框架为导向的CNN精准性能超过它,但提议的模型更牢牢地跟踪嘴部,开关减少约4倍,长度更长。 在真实的事件传感器上,它虽然只接受模拟事件的培训,但比CNN的平时率和时间稳定性都好,在FACEMORPHIC上它保持紧凑的轨道,而CNN则跳过框架。 结果表明,时间记忆的转移优于基于事件的唇位化的空间外观,时间稳定性应与准确性一并报告。
